rows.what: Parked receiver swept: 2,000.08 USDC from 0xD734.. to 0x9e5f... Its gas was bridged from its own Base twin via Across (Base gas came from attacker wallet 0xf37e..). 0x9e5f.. now holds 3,613 USDC on Ethereum.
Parked receiver swept: 1,599.93 USDC from 0x8ce6.. to 0x9e5f.., which now holds 1,613 USDC on Ethereum.
Ethereum sweeps resume: 0x746f.. gets gas from swept receiver 0x76EA.. (19:31:47) and sends its 5.94 USDC to gas hub 0x9e5f... This ties the 17:16 rehearsal withdrawal to the attacker.
Base: gas wallet 0xf37e.. hands its entire 0.0225 ETH to 0x746f.., an address that took a 5.94 USDC test withdrawal on Ethereum at 17:16. 0x746f.. is now the attacker gas wallet on Base.
BNB Chain scan: 45 relayer withdrawals since 15:00 UTC; 37,380 USDT stolen and tokenized-stock tokens parked in 8 fresh addresses. 23 further chains checked: no Fluidkey relayer there

Ethereum: gas relay 0x9461.. and gas feeder 0xdc70.. pass their leftover ETH to 0x9e5f.. (a swept Base receiver), which becomes a new gas hub (0.0125 ETH). The same step preceded the 18:35 Ethereum sweeps, so sweeps of parked Ethereum addresses may resume (inference).

Ethereum: 0x13a9.. receives the bridged proceeds of its Base USDC and forwards them to fresh collector 0x1351..: 1.0 ETH test at 19:20:11, then 90.38 ETH (91.38 ETH in total). A lookalike address (0x13517f..18b5) is an address poisoner, not the attacker.
Base: consolidator 0x13a9.. has bridged all 162,635 USDC to Ethereum by 19:21 (Across / Circle CCTP routes, USDC burned on Base). Nothing is left on Base to freeze.

Base: second sweep wave. Gas wallet 0xf37e.. funds 12 more parked addresses (19:10-19:11), which send 39,609 USDC in total to consolidator 0x13a99d2d.. (19:14-19:15). The consolidator has bridged about 61,000 USDC to Ethereum so far and holds 101,635 USDC on Base at 19:17. Tx is the first gas transfer.
Ethereum: 0x3925.. forwards its remaining 133.48 ETH to 0xd557.., which now holds 134.48 ETH.

Collector 3 (0x3925..) sends a 1.0 ETH test to fresh address 0xd557..; it still holds 133.5 ETH. A lookalike address (0xd55799..f825) dusted 0x3925.. at 19:10, an address-poisoning attempt, not the attacker.
Ethereum: 0x13a99d2d.. (same address as the Base consolidator) receives 0.56 ETH, the bridged 1,000 USDC test. The remaining 122k USDC is expected to follow via CCTP, as with 0x3925045e...

Base: six parked addresses swept into consolidator 0x13a99d2d.. 19:05-19:09: 28,238 USDC from 0x8ce6.., 27,276 from 0x3e73.., 20,929 from 0x08d2.., 20,339 from 0x5be9.., 14,446 from 0xdf57.., 11,799 from 0xa423... 0x5be9.. got its gas from 0xf37e.. (attacker link). Still holds 122,027 USDC on Base at 19:13 (freezable); sent a 1,000 USDC Across test at 19:08.
Ethereum: 0xf820.. forwards its entire 145.36 ETH to collector 0xc061.., which now holds 170.3 ETH.

Base consolidator 0x3925045e.. bridges all 237,824 USDC to Ethereum through Circle CCTP (USDC burned on Base 18:59-19:07, swapped to ETH on arrival). The same address on Ethereum holds 134.5 ETH at 19:10. Tx is one of the Base burns.

Funds reached Across (sponsored Circle CCTP route) on Base: 0x3925045e.. burned 236,824 USDC through it 19:01-19:07, paid out as ETH on Ethereum. The USDC is burned, so Circle can no longer freeze it on Base.

Funds reached HiFiSwap Bridge (custodial instant-swap service, not attacker-owned): Base USDC deposited to its wallet 0x1481e584.. was paid out as 89.16 ETH to 0xf820.. and 8.9 ETH to 0x6df5.. on Ethereum (18:35-18:58). The operator holds deposit and payout records.
Ethereum: collector 0xf820.. (same address as on Base) receives 145.4 ETH: 56.2 ETH from Mayan Swift and 89.16 ETH from HiFiSwap Bridge payouts (18:55-18:58).
Consolidator 3 (0x6df5..) sends its entire 24.42 ETH to new collector 0xc061..; that wallet also got 0.56 ETH from a THORChain swap at 18:52.

Base: four parked addresses swept into fresh wallet 0x3925045e..: 122,250 USDC from 0xf37e.., 45,826 from 0xfd7b.., 35,383 from 0x2239.., 35,364 from 0x74a5.. (18:54-18:56). It holds 237,824 USDC and sent a 1,000 USDC test (swapped to WETH, into the Across bridge) at 18:59. Attacker link inferred from the pattern; gas source not verified.
Ethereum history check done: no drain pattern on 17 or 18 Nov; 0x1F32 reclassified as a victim rescuing their own funds
Funds reached the Mayan bridge on Base (MayanForwarder2): 100,000 USDC from 0xf820.. (18:51-18:53), delivered as 56.2 ETH on Ethereum via Mayan Swift.

Base: the 259,606 USDC parked at 0xf820.. moved out 18:50-18:58: 100,000 USDC through the Mayan bridge (MayanForwarder) and 158,596 USDC to HiFiSwap Bridge deposit wallet 0x1481e584... Both paid out ETH on Ethereum to the same address 0xf820.. (145.4 ETH in total).
Base scan complete: about 834k USDC stolen there; about 414k still parked in 36 fresh addresses
Base: largest haul, 259,606 USDC, moved to a fresh address where it still sat at 18:48
Other chains checked: about $39.6k parked in fresh addresses on Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon and Gnosis, including 29,754 USDT on Optimism
Consolidator 3 receives the 27,933 USDT from both sweeps and sends 20.4 ETH to collector 2
Parked receiver swept: 12,966 USDT moved out
Parked receiver swept: 14,967 USDT moved out
Consolidator 2 sends another 45.4 ETH to collector 2 (84.3 ETH total)
Swept receiver pays gas to the next parked addresses (0xc8e4… and 0x76EA…)
Consolidator 2 finishes swapping its USDC to ETH
Tracker published; balances polled every few minutes
Parked receiver swept: 50,680 USDT + 30,631 USDC to consolidator 2
Consolidator 2 sends 38.9 ETH onward
Ops wallet pays gas to consolidator 2, linking the parked addresses to the Tornado-funded cluster
Parked receiver swept: 69,526 USDC to consolidator 2
Last Fluidkey relayer transaction; relayer silent since

Funds reached NEAR Intents (cross-chain swap service, not attacker-owned): 5,940.88 USDC bridged from Base by the swapper at 18:01 was paid out as 3.35 ETH to collector 0x1986.. on Ethereum. The service operators hold the order records.
One account drained: 5,457 USDC + 0.54 ETH to a fresh address
BNB Chain: 37,010 USDT taken from one account to a fresh address, later sent to consolidator 3 and on to the HiFiSwap bridge
345 ETH sent to collector
139.8k USDC bridged in from another chain via Relay, swapped to 78.75 ETH
Swapper converts the stablecoins to about 267 ETH
Base: first theft there, 127,728 USDC from 10 accounts to the first receiver
First large drain: 415,783 USDT + 60,184 USDC to first receiver
Attacker ops wallet funded from Tornado Cash

Recon wallet 0x9140.. funded with 0.1 ETH from Tornado Cash (38 min before the ops wallet), bridged to Base at 15:12; on Base it got ETH from the attacker swapper and sent dust to test safes 15:13-17:16 and to two victim safes at 17:27, a minute before the first drain. Purpose inferred, not proven.
Possible early phase (about 60% confidence): about $18.7k from 7 accounts to four fresh addresses, swapped to ETH through the same venues the attacker used later
